conclusions: One same-site JS icon survives: Iran Football Source’s golden football (48x48 PNG), captured in July 2013.
Six toolbar roles plus Lock have matching unmodified artwork in the related Java client family. Each role has exactly one byte hash across its occurrences.
Wahid Futbol uses the same seven basenames as the JAR resources after removing res.; other JS sites mostly rename them.
The JAR graphics are used as documented substitutes for missing JS artwork. Identical original JS graphics cannot be established without the missing files.
A pixel-hash scan of 325 small (12..64 pixel) archived images found no second copy of the golden football. Renamed missing artwork cannot be identified conclusively.
